## Problem or Use Case
Explain the evaluation challenge or workflow need that motivates this feature.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how the feature, metric, or CLI option should work.

## Methodological & Reproducibility Considerations
If proposing a new metric or dataset, describe its deterministic rules and known limitations.
